children: Russia's central bank on Wednesday raised its forecast for Russian banks' 2026 profits to 3.9-4.4 trillion roubles ($95.62 billion), up from a previous estimate of 3.4-3.9 trillion roubles.
For the first seven months of the year, Russian banks posted a net profit of 2.8 trillion roubles, according to central bank data.
